description: This Scala source file defines a custom ExecutorService implementation called BlockingThreadPoolExecutorService, which manages task submission with throttling using a semaphore. It is part of the Apache Spark project, specifically in the util package, and provides a thread pool with controlled task submission capacity.

classes.name: BlockingThreadPoolExecutorService
classes.description: A thread pool executor that throttles task submission using a semaphore, inspired by Apache S4's BlockingThreadPoolExecutorService.

methods.name: shutdownNow
methods.description: Attempts to stop all actively executing tasks and halts the processing of waiting tasks.

methods.name: isShutdown
methods.description: Checks if the executor has been shut down.

methods.name: isTerminated
methods.description: Checks if all tasks have completed following shutdown.

methods.name: awaitTermination
methods.description: Blocks until all tasks have completed execution after a shutdown request, or the timeout occurs.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Submits a task for execution, acquiring a permit before delegating to the underlying thread pool.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes a Runnable task, acquiring a permit before execution.
